script_text:
Aquarius, an Air sign ruled by Saturn and Uranus, this week a power switch flips in your career chart.

As the Sun enters Sagittarius and sextiles Pluto in your 1st House, you shine Monday. Mercury squares Saturn in your 2nd House, so keep spending tight, but Mercury trines Jupiter in your 7th House by Wednesday, making negotiations and love conversations favorable.

The shift arrives when Venus sextiles Pluto from your 10th House, boosting reputation.

Venus in Scorpio powers your work, while Jupiter trine Saturn from your 7th to 2nd House supports weekend money talks. Uranus in Gemini in your 5th House adds romantic sparks.

Wednesday is your power day because Mercury trines Jupiter in your 7th House. Monday is the hardest because Mercury squares Saturn in your 2nd House.

Use Wednesday to pitch, sign, or ask; protect your cash on Monday. Follow for daily updates.
